title: Machine learning predicts antimicrobial proteins in leprosy reversal-reaction skin lesions
summary: RNA-seq of paired skin biopsies from 9 leprosy patients before and at reversal reaction showed a 64-gene antimicrobial signature, and a machine-learning classifier predicting membrane-permeabilizing proteins selected 28 genes. S100A7, S100A8, CCL17 and CCL19 showed antimicrobial activity against M. leprae, with membrane damage on scanning electron microscopy. Only 9 patients; classifier name, held-out performance and effect sizes were not read.

evidence.tested: In vitro assays in M. leprae-infected macrophages and axenic cultures, and scanning electron microscopy.
evidence.unknown: Classifier performance; in vivo relevance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning classifier prioritised candidate antimicrobial genes.
